text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday leaves Tunis for a three day offical visit to Argentina.
- In a message to the extraordinary Islamic Summit held this weekend in Islamabad, Ben Ali calls for a defence of Islam's values of moderation and tolerance.
- Egypt and Tunisia hold talks in Cairo on ways to boost trade exchanges between the two countries.
- President Ben Ali called for a joint Islamic market in a speech delivered on his behalf by Tunisian Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari at the Islamic Summit in Islamabad.
